title: Blue Pine Sea-clusion | Royal Destinations
meta_description: LSV (Low Speed Vehicle) Available And Community Pool - Blue Pine Sea-clusion By Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Blue Pine Sea-clusion by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 51 Cullman Avenue Details: Blue Pine Sea-clusion is a serene getaway in Seagrove’s Grove by the Sea. Designed for accessibility, it features a chair lift for easy first-floor access. The open living area flows into a modern gourmet kitchen, alongside a laundry/pantry, half bath, and queen en suite with a walk-in shower. Relax on the screened front porch or in the library. Upstairs, a spacious king master with a kids’ bunk room, a second king master, and two bedrooms with a Jack-and-Jill bath offer plenty of space. The carriage house adds privacy with a king bed, twin beds, and a private bath. Enjoy the back porch, fire pit, tennis courts, pools, and easy access to the beach, Seaside, and 30A fun. Four adult bikes are included, and the LSV is available for rent. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Beach Access (across 30A, 0.4 miles) -Firepit and Gas Grill -Screened Front Porch and Covered Back Porch with Seating and Dining -Gaming Table -Large off-street Parking Area -4 Adult Bikes -Community Pool (half a block away) -Tennis Courts (across the street) and Basketball Court (across the street) -*LSV (Low Speed Vehicle) Available *$600 Fee Applicable (pre-tax); Please contact Reservations to add this amenity to your stay. Home Configuration: Sleeps: 12 Adults, 4 Children 6 Bedrooms / 5 Full Baths / 1 Half Bath First Floor: -Bedroom 1: Queen Bed with Private Bath, Walk-in Shower -Screened Front Porch and Covered Back Porch -Custom Gourmet Kitchen with Bar Seating -Open Living Room / Dining Room / Library Den -Laundry / Half Bath Second Floor: -Bedroom 2: Master Suite: King Bed, Private Bath with Garden Tub, Walk-in Shower, Double Vanities, Walk-in closet, adjoining bunkroom with 2 Twin Bunks -Bedroom 3: Second Master Bedroom Suite: King Bed, Private Bath -Bedroom 4: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom -Bedroom 5: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom Carriage House: -Bedroom 6: King Bed, adjoining twin beds, Private Bath with Walk-in Shower. Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
